text: Before you light a single deeya this year, know why.
sub: Before you light a single diya this year, know why.
asr: Before you light a single D of this year, know why.

text: Five stories. Five lamps. And almost nobody knows all of them.
sub: Five stories. Five lamps. And almost nobody knows all of them.

text: The first lamp is for a prince.
sub: The first lamp is for a prince.

text: Ram was sent into the forest for fourteen years, with Sita, and his brother Lakshman.
sub: Ram was sent into the forest for 14 years, with Sita, and his brother Lakshman.
asr: Ram was sent into the forest for 14 years, with Sita, and his brother Lakshman.

text: There, the demon king Ravana stole See-tah away, to Lanka.
sub: There, the demon king Ravana stole Sita away, to Lanka.
asr: There, the Demon King Ravana Stole sitar away, to Lanka.

text: Ram crossed the sea on a bridge of stones. With Hanuman and an army of monkeys, he fought Ravana, and won.
sub: Ram crossed the sea on a bridge of stones. With Hanuman and an army of monkeys, he fought Ravana, and won.

text: When Ram came home, it was the darkest night of the month.
sub: When Ram came home, it was the darkest night of the month.

text: So the people of Uh-yodh-yah lit a lamp in every window, to light his way.
sub: So the people of Ayodhya lit a lamp in every window, to light his way.
asr: So the people of Ayodhya lit a lamp in every window, to light his way.

text: The second lamp is for a goddess.
sub: The second lamp is for a goddess.

text: Long ago, gods and demons churned the cosmic ocean, with a mountain for a rod, and a great serpent for a rope.
sub: Long ago, gods and demons churned the cosmic ocean, with a mountain for a rod, and a great serpent for a rope.

text: Out of the waves rose Lakshmi, goddess of wealth and good fortune.
sub: Out of the waves rose Lakshmi, goddess of wealth and good fortune.

text: So on Diwali night, families clean their homes, open their doors, and light lamps, to welcome her in.
sub: So on Diwali night, families clean their homes, open their doors, and light lamps, to welcome her in.

text: The third lamp is for freedom.
sub: The third lamp is for freedom.

text: The demon Narakasura had locked sixteen thousand women in his fortress.
sub: The demon Narakasura had locked 16,000 women in his fortress.
asr: The demon Naracasura had locked 16,000 women in his fortress.

text: Krishna and his queen, Sutt-yah-bhaama, rode out against him, and set every one of them free.
sub: Krishna and his queen Satyabhama rode out against him, and set every one of them free.
asr: Krishna and his queen, Satyabhama, rode out against him and set every one of them free.

text: In the south of India, that victory is Deepa-vuh-lee itself.
sub: In the south of India, that victory is Deepavali itself.
asr: In the south of India, that victory is deep of Ali itself.

text: The fourth lamp is for a promise.
sub: The fourth lamp is for a promise.

text: The emperor had imprisoned the sixth Sikh Guru, Guru Hargobind, in Gwalior Fort.
sub: The emperor had imprisoned the sixth Sikh Guru, Guru Hargobind, in Gwalior Fort.
asr: The emperor had imprisoned the sixth Sikh Guru, Guru Hargabind, in Gwalior Fort.

text: When he was freed, he would not leave alone. Fifty-two kings held the tails of his robe, and walked out with him.
sub: When he was freed, he would not leave alone. 52 kings held the tails of his robe, and walked out with him.
asr: When he was freed, he would not leave alone. 52 kings held the tails of his robe, and walked out with him.

text: Sikhs call it Bandi Chhor Divas, the day of release. And the Golden Temple shines with light.
sub: Sikhs call it Bandi Chhor Divas, the day of release. And the Golden Temple shines with light.

text: The fifth lamp is for a teacher.
sub: The fifth lamp is for a teacher.

text: On this night, Jains believe, Lord Mahavira attained nirvana at Pavapuri.
sub: On this night, Jains believe, Lord Mahavira attained nirvana at Pavapuri.
asr: On this night, Jane's believe, Lord Mahavira attained nirvana at Pavapuri.

text: The great light of knowledge was gone. So people lit small lamps, to keep it with them.
sub: The great light of knowledge was gone. So people lit small lamps, to keep it with them.

text: Five stories. Five lamps.
sub: Five stories. Five lamps.

text: And every one of them ends the same way.
sub: And every one of them ends the same way.

text: Darkness loses.
sub: Darkness loses.

text: So this year, when you light your deeya, you're lighting all five.
sub: So this year, when you light your diya, you're lighting all five.
asr: So this year, when you light your DIA, you're lighting all five.

text: Happy Diwali.
sub: Happy Diwali.
